motion.name: settle
motion.value: settle 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; from transform: scaleY(0.82); transform-origin: bottom; stagger 70ms per layer
motion.purpose: Strata layers settle upward once when a plan appears. Removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Call-to-action Button

components.css: .ds-btn-cta { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); color: #fff; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 15px/1.45 var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-cta:hover { background: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); } .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Varnish fill, one per plan action stack.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: block; text-align: center; background: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); color: #fff; padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 15px/1.45 var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Varnish outline for the other actions in a stack.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: block; text-align: center; background: transparent; color: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); border: 1px solid var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); padding: 12px; border-radius: 8px; font: 600 15px/1.45 var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); text-decoration: none; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: var(--color-sky-deep, #d3dee5); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Segmented Control

components.css: .ds-seg { display: flex; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); border-radius: 8px; } .ds-seg button { flex: 1; padding: 10px 0; border: 0; border-left: 1px solid var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); background: transparent; color: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); font: 600 15px/1.45 var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); cursor: pointer; } .ds-seg button:first-child { border-left: 0; } .ds-seg button:hover { background: var(--color-sky-deep, #d3dee5); } .ds-seg button[aria-checked="true"] { background: var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); color: #fff; } .ds-seg button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: White well with varnish border and a stacked semibold label.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); font: 600 13px/1.4 var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; margin-top: 4px; padding: 8px 12px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); border-radius: 8px; font: 400 15px/1.45 var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); color: inherit; accent-color: var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); caret-color: var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.description: Quantity control on list rows with 40px targets.
components.html: 2
components.css: .ds-stepper { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #fff; border: 1px solid var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); border-radius: 8px; color: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); } .ds-stepper button { display: grid; place-items: center; width: 40px; height: 40px; border: 0; background: none; color: inherit; cursor: pointer; } .ds-stepper button:disabled { opacity: 0.3; } .ds-stepper button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-stepper span { width: 28px; text-align: center; font: 600 15px/1.45 var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

components.description: Sage chip under the total; savings only.

components.name: Top Bar
components.description: Sticky varnish bar with wordmark and one tan action.
components.html: UtahCartEdit list
components.css: .ds-topbar { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; padding: 12px 16px; background: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); color: var(--color-tan, #f0c9a0); font-family: var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-topbar-mark { color: #fff; font-size: 18px; font-weight: 700; line-height: 1.25; letter-spacing: -0.025em; text-decoration: none; } .ds-topbar-action { color: var(--color-tan, #f0c9a0); font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.4; text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-topbar a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Strata Column
components.description: Signature: the plan's minutes stacked as sandstone layers up to the dashed time-limit rim; spare time is sky.
components.css: .ds-strata { width: 104px; margin: 0; color: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); font: 600 13px/1.25 var(--font-sans, Barlow, system-ui, sans-serif); } .ds-strata figcaption { padding-bottom: 4px; } .ds-strata-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column-reverse; height: 320px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); border-top: 2px dashed var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); background: var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); } .ds-stratum { display: flex; align-items: center; min-height: 0; padding: 0 6px; border-top: 1px solid var(--color-varnish, #2a1a14); transform-origin: bottom; animation: ds-settle 700ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) both; } .ds-navajo { background: var(--color-navajo, #e08b5b); } .ds-tan { background: var(--color-tan, #f0c9a0); } .ds-shop { background: var(--color-wingate, #b8462a); color: #fff; } .ds-strata-sky { display: flex; align-items: flex-end; min-height: 0; padding: 0 6px 4px; background: var(--color-sky, #e7eef2); font-weight: 400; } @keyframes ds-settle { from { transform: scaleY(0.82); } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-stratum { animation: none; } }

narrative.overview:
Every plan is a Utah cliff face. The minutes a trip uses stack as flat sandstone layers, one per travel leg and shop stop, up to a dashed rim that marks the user's time limit. Time left over shows as open sky above the layers. The rest of the system serves that image: a pale sky ground, desert-varnish ink, one fixed sandstone ramp, and hairline rules in place of cards.

The world is flat and dense, made for a phone held in one hand. Hierarchy comes from a four-step size ladder in a single family (Barlow), from weight, and from where the sandstone colour falls. Surfaces are never lifted or layered. A rule, a fill, or a change of ink does all the separating. The chosen plan fills the screen and the other plans sit one horizontal swipe away.

The build rejects the category default of white cards with a green button and a map thumbnail.
keyCharacteristics: Sky-pale ground, varnish ink, one sandstone ramp (Wingate, Navajo, tan) plus sage for savings.
Flat colour only: no gradients, no shadows, no tints beyond the ramp.
1px varnish hairlines separate content; no cards.
One family, four sizes (13 / 15 / 18 / 44px), tabular figures everywhere.
Small radii (4px and 8px); the strata column itself is square.
One signature motion: layers settle upward from the base, once.

rules.name: The Fixed Ramp Rule
rules.body: The colours above are the whole palette. Express a new state with a ramp colour or with varnish at reduced opacity (25% for soft rules, 40% for disabled outlines), never with a new hue or tint.

rules.name: The Sandstone Is Time Rule
rules.body: Navajo and tan mean travel minutes and Wingate means shop minutes inside the strata. Outside the strata, Wingate means "selected" or "act now". Sage means money saved and nothing else.

rules.name: The Four-Step Ladder Rule
rules.body: Only 13, 15, 18 and 44px exist. Build hierarchy from weight (400 / 600 / 700) and ink (varnish vs. soft varnish) before you reach for another size.

rules.name: The Ledger Figures Rule
rules.body: Every number uses tabular figures. Write durations as "about N min" and money with two decimals.

rules.name: The Hairline Rule
rules.body: Separate with 1px varnish lines: full strength under a section or group header, 25% for rows and soft dividers. Don't use cards, shadows, or fill blocks to group content.

dos: Do take every colour from the fixed ramp, and use varnish opacity (25%, 40%) for soft rules and disabled outlines.
Do separate content with 1px varnish hairlines and leave surfaces flat.
Do keep type to the four sizes (13 / 15 / 18 / 44px) in Barlow with tabular figures.
Do give each action stack exactly one filled button, and swap varnish and Wingate on hover.
Do keep the settle motion for strata layers only, and remove it under reduced-motion.
Do label demo prices and estimated times in caption text next to the numbers they qualify.
donts: Don't use white cards, shadows, gradients or blurs. The build is flat colour on sky.
Don't add a green brand button or a map thumbnail. Those are the category default this world rejects.
Don't use sage for anything except savings, or navajo outside the strata.
Don't use dashed lines except for the time-limit rim.
Don't add a second typeface or sizes between the four ladder steps.
